entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted software. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, a self-hosted server, and a cloud platform.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight centers agent memory on three operations: retain, recall, and reflect. It offers Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and Go clients, and supports multiple LLM providers, including local options.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database and official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes knowledge, memories, and skills in one filesystem. Its directory-scoped search and L0, L1, and L2 context-loading tiers make it a distinct option for managing what agents retrieve and load.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee builds connected memory from documents, code, and conversations to provide agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It also supports local text processing without an LLM and includes a CLI for remembering and recalling text.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, as well as an official Hermes Agent memory provider, that extracts facts and handles updates, contradictions, and forgetting. Its connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub, and it offers plugins, an MCP server, and JavaScript and Python API clients.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores sourced facts and supports corrections and withdrawal. It can share memory across agents, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents and the upstream library used by the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It stores messages and events on sessions, reasons in the background to update peer representations, and can be used as a managed service, local CLI, or self-hosted FastAPI server.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repository, with Git-like versioning for managing a context tree. It offers five-tier retrieval, an interactive TUI and REPL, and support for 20 LLM providers and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne describes itself as a zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system for Hermes agents, with SQLite-backed storage and one pure-Python dependency. Agents can integrate through MCP, native providers, or its Python SDK.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto consolidates memories and reconciles conflicting information, then briefs agents with relevant memories before they act. It also supports importing and exporting memories through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that includes vector search and structured facts. Its local infrastructure uses Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and its Ground Truth hierarchy is designed to ensure the agent prioritizes injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving context harness for helping agents succeed on complex tasks. It runs tasks against evaluation, keeps useful lessons while discarding dead ends, and leaves traces, reports, and playbooks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Hermes Agent plugin uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to persist messages, with the stated goal of never losing a message. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from that stored context.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: Deja-vu indexes session history from coding agents so users can search months of past work, including older sessions. It provides terminal search and command-line summaries, with local indexing and SSH sync between machines.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables self-hosted, cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers and local inference servers, and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity, memory, and secrets layer with portable state across Hermes Agent and other listed agent harnesses. It can import files, webpages, and agent conversations, and includes a dashboard for browsing memory and sources.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur stores shared agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk, providing an open format for multi-agent systems. It offers local search after a one-time model download, with keyword fallback; its README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500).
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device, local-first memory and context engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory stores durable agent memory locally in a SQLite file and provides FTS5 search with a five-tier schema. Its five-package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering for prefix-cache sharing, including for text and multimodal context. Its context index supports reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling, and it integrates with vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This Hermes memory plugin uses an embedded backend by default, with an HTTP backend also available. Its recall results include a why_retrieved reason, and it supports contradiction tracking and memory canonicalization.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This agent-driven CLI maintains a persistent, source-grounded Wiki that can be recalled and updated across sessions. It includes citations and history, and does not require embeddings or a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn provides long-term, cross-project memory for AI coding agents, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. It stores inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata, uses a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval, and integrates through MCP servers and host-specific plugins.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd uses an anticipatory cache that watches agent session logs to prefetch context. It pairs local-first storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack combines Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace under a single memory owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma, and provides the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep builds reflective memory with semantic search that combines BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal. It can index codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support, while edge tags link stored notes through navigable, bidirectional relationships.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema token overhead by ranking tools locally with keywords, and supports Tool Search. It integrates as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19+ and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS provides a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other compatible coding agents. Its workflows cover migrations, handoffs, and memory proposals, with integrations that remain opt-in rather than activating automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only Hermes memory plugin stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships. Its importance-weighted recall is designed to surface higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources to support capability discovery and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with three lifecycle hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with on-demand summarization and a trace.jsonl audit log of prefetch operations. It supports immediate event deletion, rather than retaining persistent summaries after deletion.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind extracts the original goal from the first user turn of a long Claude Code or Codex session, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: The XMemo plugin adds durable, cross-session memory to Hermes Agent, using lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots. It includes a local SQLite cache and write outbox, and can read memories from other connected agents for cross-agent continuity.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools to search and manually store memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, including semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A. Its slash commands cover search, file reads, context, and Q&A, while repo sync and indexed git-history search support repository workflows.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides encrypted long-term memory for Hermes Agent, with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest enabled by default. It combines HNSW approximate-nearest-neighbor, sparse, and FM-index retrieval, and can run through native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides Hermes Agent memory tools, including 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can checkpoint context automatically during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit is a file-based memory-curation loop that works with Markdown and produces JSON diffs for review, without a database. Its “rot” and “lint” curators identify stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers provides composable skills and a software-development workflow that guides agents through specification, design sign-off, planning, and subagent execution. Its separately installed harness support and documentation for many harnesses make it a broad option for teams building structured agent workflows.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first system for design and prototyping, with skills, templates, design systems, and plugins. It supports multiple coding agents—including Hermes Agent—through skills, CLI, MCP, or runtime adapters, making it a design-focused addition to an agent skills list.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project offers structured cybersecurity skills spanning 34 security domains, with mappings to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. Its compatibility with more than 26 AI platforms makes it a wide-ranging security skills collection for agents.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, while diagramctl and an optional MCP server provide ways to work with the diagrams.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet-court-skill provides a master router and connector skills for agent-to-agent commerce, alongside vendored copies of official protocol skills. It also adds verification and dispute resolution, distinguishing it as a skill set focused on trust and oversight.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid-ai-writing audits prose for detectable AI writing patterns, either flagging them in detect mode or rewriting content in rewrite mode. Rewriting applies up to two editing passes and verifies when possible; in-place editing is limited to prose files.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses background evolution to deduplicate and improve skills, and unifies skill libraries across agents, devices, and team members. Its integrations include Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs, making it relevant for managing shared skill collections.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills, with compatibility for Claude Code, Codex, and agent-skills.io-compatible agents. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder, offering a distinct focus on project-based continuity.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: PM-Claude-skills provides 822 professional agent skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants. The skills are plain Markdown files, and the README lists tasks such as writing PRDs and decoding leases.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube-skills covers transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor. It requires a TranscriptAPI key, with a 100-credit free tier noted in the project highlights.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes-skill-factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills, then generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save the detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super-hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical instructions for specific tasks and includes pre-built lenses for different domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots, adding an explicit review of potential gaps.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, with progressive disclosure and remote skill registries from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and sandboxed script execution, making it a fit for agents that need to use skills while isolating untrusted scripts.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Creates .lit.md documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code, then extracts runnable files with a tangler. Source edits can also be synced back into the literate document, supporting workflows that keep code and its explanation together.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, while a PASS/FAIL spec review gate adds an explicit review step.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents, with SQLite-backed storage and event logging through a mechanism kernel. It also coordinates agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and distributes prompt-first methods as Markdown recipes and skills.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares agent memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, bringing memory and model replacement into one project.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language skills in SKILL.md format alongside guides for installing, configuring, and using Hermes Agent. Its focus on Portuguese resources and contributions through forks and pull requests makes it a community-oriented option for Hermes users.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Collects official FLUX skills for image and video generation prompting, including BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. The repository also includes a FLUX 3 video suite with eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills that follow the Agent Skills specification, with installation documented through npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills. The README describes the repository as community examples only.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agentskills.io-compliant instructions from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It supports both automated and step-by-step workflows, with tools for testing and exporting skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a workflow language for AI that checks workflows before calling a model and runs with a model of your choice. It also verifies a tamper-evident record for each run, bringing validation and run records into the workflow.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with both a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI. Its installation support resolves dependencies recursively, and it also includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures make recovery part of the execution workflow.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This Hermes Agent skill manages Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS with Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for validating credentials and configuring access.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub is a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills with one click. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and federates search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye narrows the skills Hermes Agent considers before making an LLM call, using five retrieval layers that include hard triggers and semantic embeddings. It can degrade gracefully when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system with habits, study blocks, and agent control through MCP. It stores data in a single local SQLite file and includes a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs read-only adversarial code review, using parallel subagents to examine edge cases, adversarial concerns, and integration. It combines a deterministic pre-scan with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill simplifies code through three parallel agents focused on Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness. It supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust, with a tiered application process and an approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize for Hermes adapts verified procedures for multi-story task decomposition, requiring evidence-based verification gates. It also provides an investigation protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, plus a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: Hermes Cybersec Lab provides a cybersecurity lab with skills, tools, and integrations for 28 frameworks and standards. Its highlights include 2,077 skills across multiple repositories and 131 or more tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: Skillsdotnet is a C#/.NET implementation of agentskills.io with MCP integration. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and uses Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading, with automatic registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is a local, read-only observability dashboard for tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics in real time. It desensitizes local logs and supports optional incident alerts through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This collection provides plain Markdown agent skills for code review and session management, including multi-session reconciliation and worktree recovery. Skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using VHS tape files or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries, and can optimize GIFs to target sizes under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches more than 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills, then provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins. Its integrations include MCP-compatible clients such as Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This skill builds Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also monitors official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic feedback loop analyzes agent session history to identify skill coverage gaps and draft improvement proposals. Updates are gated by deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators, and it runs locally with Python’s standard library without daemons or external services.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using the path syntax for native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, or WSL. They also select and verify existing Python interpreters that are compatible with a project.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agent skills for social data, CRM management, and lead enrichment, with support for Claude Code, Cursor, and other agentskills.io-compliant clients. It also includes an MCP server for browser-based OAuth authentication.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection of Hermes skills transcribes Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, removes common Chinese AI-writing patterns with a rule-based engine, and extracts structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision. Its tools cover video transcription, text editing, OCR, and e-commerce materials.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents browse open support bounties, buy ticket context, and submit answers for human review; winning answers are paid in USDC. It also supports creating a bounty board and provides public wallet earnings records.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests AI agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It produces certificates with Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for certificate verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server, exposing 191 tools. It also includes five workflow skills and supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Alphapipeline is a quantitative risk and slippage guard for AI agents, covering Polymarket L2 VWAP, on-chain DEX, and cross-venue arbitrage through a remote MCP server. Its token-risk tools return raw data rather than a safety verdict, and x402 payments use USDC on Base.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates Chinese news briefings at multiple geographic scales, from global to street level. It produces structured reports with conclusions and suggested actions, and uses semantic memory of user interests to expand searches.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This project provides an MCP endpoint for Western and Vedic astrology with deterministic results and SHA-256 verification. The endpoint requires no authentication, with per-call REST payments available through x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that loads server metadata and tool schemas incrementally, using a three-layer approach to minimize token usage. Its socket-based daemon maintains persistent connections, making it a distinct fit for Hermes Agent skills focused on efficient MCP discovery and access.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project packages AI coding agents and development tools, including Hermes, for use with Nix. Its daily updates and per-tool `nix run` commands make it a package-based option for running agents.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. Its highlights include an ARM64 Android installer for Antigravity CLI, OpenClaw configuration guides, and hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides a Termux installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android, using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell command execution, and external providers or local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with single-writer safeguards for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD workflows, and offers configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes assistant to Android through Termux or to iOS through iSH. It also supports Telegram voice and file messaging, plus scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing through NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and provides configurable policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It includes searchable logs, metrics, and alert rules, with access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image for Hermes Agent that includes mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project provides a Nix package and NixOS module for declarative Hermes deployment, including configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It supports both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills, with secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first web control plane for operating multiple Hermes Agent instances, each with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular tool, path, and network permission policies.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable Hermes Agent package distributed through GitHub Releases that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It offers Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project sets up Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework in which analysts assess company fundamentals and aggregate sentiment from news headlines, StockTwits, and Reddit. Selected analysts work in parallel with their own tools, bringing multiple perspectives to trading analysis.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control is a self-hosted orchestration system for dispatching tasks and running multi-agent workflows, with controls for agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It offers a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API, and can be installed with Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires provides TUI and web control surfaces for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, and Gemini. Persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and a web dashboard with terminal access and diffs support ongoing work across agents and repositories.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture and task bus support orchestrator-to-specialist delegation, and it includes skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: SwarmClaw is a framework for building autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It combines durable agent memory and MCP tool integration with visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a mission-control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. Its Kanban board tracks task status and review queues, while live streams show agent reasoning and tool execution; proposed task completions require human verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A strict pipeline architecture and Master Orchestrator handle routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for collaboration between Leader and Specialist agents, using Hermes Agent profiles and Hermes Kanban for task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP for local tool and communication handling, with a real-time UI for agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations and provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator runs an agent-versus-agent arena in which nine autonomous agents are organized into two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, and a real-time dashboard displays agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel implements a local Mixture-of-Agents stack by querying multiple models in parallel and synthesizing their outputs. Hermes handles task routing and tool-calling, and the project is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a full project graph with `codegraph init`, using structural extraction and cross-file resolution for supported languages. Its MCP support lets Hermes Agent and other coding agents use pre-indexed code knowledge, with the stated aim of reducing token usage and tool calls.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI for tracking token consumption and costs across Hermes and other AI coding agents. Its views cover sessions, models, daily summaries, and stats, and it can submit usage data to a leaderboard or create a public profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude-tap records coding-agent API traffic and provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported trace sessions. It supports tools including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Cursor CLI, and redacts common authentication headers before recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token-monitor tracks token usage, costs, and rate limits across 46+ AI coding tools, including Hermes Agent. It also shows historical trends and usage breakdowns, with multi-device sync for viewing data across devices.
entries.bergside/typeui: Typeui provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build UI with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider that supports markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes adds an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes skills for product briefs, design handoffs, and implementation, plus seven agents for roles across the product lifecycle and GitHub integration for issue and pull request delivery.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins is a community CLI for customizing the Hermes terminal UI with banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. YAML-based configuration supports theme creation, with options including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a command-line static linter for AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, with HERM v1.1 scoring. It scans prompts, tool definitions, schemas, and agent files, then reports findings with specific fixes and supported line references.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging using the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable @handles. It also facilitates commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel-browser is an AI-native browser for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. Its supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and it supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports Hermes Agent’s brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, where it runs natively without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee-integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages with two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for workflows described as achieving 90–99% token savings. It also includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, with automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md provides per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, with local configuration and skills. It can switch between default and scoped agents and supports project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This project automates installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers ranging from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This tool migrates OpenClaw data—including SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives—to Hermes. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes YAML and JSON formats and sets up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco monitors AI agents with passive analysis or scheduled active probing, and can automatically recover multi-agent systems. Its native Hermes plugin exports real-time conversation telemetry and uses local file changes to help detect performance drift.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes Voice adds voice interaction with wake-word support, adaptive turn-taking, and barge-in capabilities. It runs offline without API keys or accounts and supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes Startup is a local runtime for pursuing online opportunities, operating with zero network access by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: Hermes Memoss is a memory plugin with semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage. It provides tools to search, add, and delete memories, and includes a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC-Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with support for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It pairs a built-in agent with file access, web search, and MCP tools, and includes 21 ready-to-use assistants.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI brings Hermes Agent to the web and phone through a three-panel interface for sessions, chat, and workspace files. Its file browser includes inline previews, and the project is built with Python and vanilla JavaScript without a build step.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a desktop companion for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools, and the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a web dashboard for Hermes Agent, with multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It also offers shared and group chats, visual workflows, persistent sessions, and tools for files, voice, devices, and agent management; desktop apps are available for Windows, macOS, and Linux, alongside npm and Docker options.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace is a native web workspace that brings chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector panel together. Its features include Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, an MCP catalog, and a workspace file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, delegate with @, or queue tasks to run in worktrees; it includes 15 built-in agents, and ACP agents can also join.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a native Mac workspace that connects directly to Hermes hosts locally or over SSH. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, plus an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS and native window and process management. It includes a Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health checks and update capabilities, alongside interfaces for chat, memory management, and LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local, cloud, or self-hosted remote Hermes gateway. Users can attach page context, files, or staged screenshots, while Chromium-only Hermes Control can operate tabs.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent, pairing with a hermes-webui server. It is a client-only app for iOS 18 and later, so users run the server themselves; the project says it is free and has no analytics or tracking.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, and support for custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It tracks agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and includes a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for Hermes agents and other coding-agent CLIs, with analytics and a limits tracker. It lets you search session activity and resume supported sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp; session history stays on the Mac with no telemetry.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted browser dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, with tools including a terminal, file explorer, session overview, and cron management. It also provides real-time chat with tool-call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It can install Hermes Agent on fresh cloud computers with one click and includes WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects a local Hermes agent to web dashboards through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox surfaces requests with side effects for review.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI, for chatting and managing agent sessions. It also includes a kanban board for agentic work and tools for managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally running, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It offers terminal chat with streaming and file attachments, Telegram validation using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication, and background spawning for up to five concurrent agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages Hermes Agent as a Windows desktop application with a GUI and 100 tools across 20+ toolsets. It supports cloud AI and LM Studio local models, and its workflow engine handles scheduling, conditions, loops, and parallel execution.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a glassmorphic web interface for a self-hosted Hermes Agent, with chat and real-time log streaming. Its file browser and task dashboard sit alongside management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a dashboard for monitoring Hermes processes and configuration, with real-time session activity and cost tracking. It also supports inspecting conversation histories and skill source code, while keeping configuration and environment-variable views read-only.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: PAN UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It combines a marketplace for skills and MCP servers with isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a multi-agent desktop client with streaming chat, model switching, and a PM orchestrator. It supports collaboration among 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual Skill Store with 50+ curated one-click installations.
